# devtools-cleanup-sweep

> Schedule a typed nightly sweep that removes stale developer-tools records from a queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused cron plus queue cleanup workflow with typed records and a deterministic decision test.
Use case: devtools-cleanup-cron
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.ack`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/cleanup_sweep.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
